settings.label: Enabled
settings.description:
Browses what Netflix carries, and plays it in Netflix's own player full screen
Needs Chromium with Widevine (on the OSD/OS image already)

settings.label: Catalogue Region
settings.description:
The country whose Netflix catalogue to list
Titles come from TMDB, which needs a free API key in tmdb_api_key.txt
This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB
Streaming data from JustWatch

settings.label: Catalogue Language
settings.description: The language of titles and genres in the catalogue

settings.label: Scaling
settings.description:
How a 16:9 picture fills the 4:3 screen in this module
[DEFAULT] As Settings' Scaling says

settings.label: Sign in
settings.description:
Opens Netflix's sign-in page full screen, to sign in with a keyboard
This player stays signed in until Sign out

settings.label: Sign out
settings.description:
Forgets the Netflix sign-in on this player
The next visit asks for it again
